english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for a collection containing many different kinds of things.
Use this for a collection containing various or assorted kinds, rather than for a simple contrast between two things.

examples.english: This shop has a diverse range of stationery.
examples.traditional: 呢間店有各式各樣嘅文具。
